plan.scope: all available cached test images within the frozen local training region
plan.region_selection: GT used solely for fixed evaluation coverage; ranking never uses GT
plan.real_candidate_protocol: LEADER seedwise + LEADER final + v1-two-stage; rank by fixed 10px camera score; no P3P/refinement/tuning
plan.primary_new_frame_scope: newly evaluated frames within training orientation support, reported separately

manifest.region_selection: fixed training-region GT coverage for evaluation only; no GT used to rank candidates

stage1.scope: selected frames only; not full NCLT unless all test frames supplied

improved.scope: selected frames only; not full NCLT unless all test frames supplied

manifest.candidate_pool: v1-two-stage, original LEADER, all valid SC2 seedwise poses; duplicates rounded at 1e-5 removed
manifest.score: mean(min(L2 reprojection squared / 100,1)); invalid depth=1; no fitted weights
manifest.ties: within 1e-8 of minimum prefer v1; otherwise first candidate
manifest.dominance: better by at least 0.05m and 0.1deg; GT only used for evaluation labels
manifest.oracle: best available max(translation/1m, rotation/2deg), diagnostic only

direct.rotation_metric: nearest SO(3) for near-rigid float32 matrices, then atan2 angle; identical for all methods

balanced_protocol.score: 0.5 * clipped weighted LiDAR squared residual + 0.5 * fixed camera S_C
balanced_protocol.purpose: fixed candidate-scoring ablation, not a new refinement or calibrated deployment policy

manifest.protocol: rerank raw SC2 candidates, then apply the original v1 full-pool refinement once
manifest.raw_pool: original LEADER pose first plus seedwise poses; no appended already-refined v1 pose
manifest.nature: follow-up diagnostic after direct reranking; no parameter search or training
manifest.oracle: best refined pose among all raw seeds, GT only used to compute this diagnostic bound

uncertainty_scope: 8 contiguous time blocks, 10000 paired bootstrap draws; one region/date, not whole NCLT uncertainty
